description_en: Persist adaptive reasoning effort across sessions. Effort is supported on Opus 4.7, Opus 4.6, and Sonnet 4.6. Opus 4.7 supports low/medium/high/xhigh/max (xhigh sits between high and max, added in v2.1.111); Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 support low/medium/high/max (xhigh falls back to high). Defaults: Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 default to high on all plans (Pro/Max raised from medium to high in v2.1.117); Opus 4.7 defaults to xhigh on Max plan. The max value is session-only unless set via CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL. Use /effort auto to reset to model default. Also configurable via CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL environment variable. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config#adjust-effort-level
description_ja: セッション間で適応型推論の思考レベル(effort)を維持します。
use_case_ja:
- 推論対応モデル(Opus 4.7/4.6, Sonnet 4.6)において、タスクに対する思考の深さを `low` から `max` まで調整し、回答の丁寧さと速度のバランスを固定します。
- 常に深い考察を求める場合は `high` または `xhigh`、簡単なタスクにコストをかけたくない場合は `low` に設定して永続化させるのに役立ちます。
